checks.reason: Independently followed the actual interval-map composition. The k-level union approaches 1/2 within 2^(-k), while the fixed level-3 union [13/32,15/32] union [17/32,19/32] excludes 1/2 and contains all later levels; hence the stated limsup is empty. The forward-order replacement has lengths 2^(-k(k+1)/2); its separated subtrees, including skipped generations, have bounded order for every fixed positive eta. The declared Section 5 example fails, without a counterexample to Theorems 1 or 2.

A positive-area parallelogram cannot contain its translate when its area is only 1/L of that translate for L>1. The preceding average is not itself false. A direction-adjusted rectangle of area at most 6L(L+1)w contains the relevant mass w, restoring a uniform positive lower bound depending on eta and preserving the needed maximal-operator argument. This is a local enclosure error, not the main theorem's failure.

The initial allegation used mis-transcribed PDF outputs. Actual primary and separate arXiv images both show 0101 to 1010 and 0110 to 1010. Root's separate reviewer-written exhaustive check of all 120 pairs reports zero prefix violations. There is neither an established table defect nor a source-version discrepancy at these entries. Initial false evidence is retained as superseded history.
